title: Missed-Appointment Fees and the Outpatient Surgery Initial Deposit (Good Faith & Price Estimates)
content:
**Q. Does a patient's record of missed-appointment fees affect the initial deposit on a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery booking under Good Faith & Price Estimates?**

Yes. The missed-appointment fees assessed on the patient's Riverbend appointments — the fee assessments in the patient's Appointment Scheduling activity, whether for a no-show or a late cancellation — are counted when the assessment date lies fewer than twelve whole months before today's date (a month counts once its day of the month is reached, so the date exactly twelve months back is outside), a fee later waived still counting and a fee dated after today's date not counting. Two or more such fees add ten percentage points (10) to the booking's deposit percentage, exactly one adds five percentage points (5), and none adds no points. The points are added to the booking's deposit percentage before that percentage is applied.

| Fees counted | Percentage points added |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 10 |
| exactly 1 | 5 |
| none | none |

**Q. Which assessment dates fall inside the count?** (hypothetical, today being the 15th of a month)
- assessed on the 15th of the same month twelve months earlier: outside;
- assessed on the 16th of that month: inside;
- assessed later than today: not counted.

**Q. Does a waiver remove a fee from the count?** No; a fee later waived still counts.
